# NYT Cooking

> A comprehensive recipe platform from The New York Times featuring curated collections, editor-selected recipes, and cooking newsletters for weeknight meals, healthy eating, and vegetarian options.

NYT Cooking provides recipe collections organized by meal type, difficulty level, and dietary preference, with contributions from renowned food writers like Melissa Clark, Eric Kim, and Ali Slagle. The platform emphasizes practical weeknight cooking and quick meal solutions for busy home cooks.

## Key Topics

- Easy Recipes
- Quick Recipes
- Weeknight Cooking
- Vegetarian Options
- Healthy Recipes
- Pasta Recipes
- One-Pot Meals
- Sheet-Pan Dinners
- Editors' Picks
- Recipe Collections
- Newsletter
- Comfort Food
- Quick Meals
- Vegetarian Recipes
- Weeknight Meals

## Popular Collections & Essentials

- [Our 50 Most Popular Recipes of All Time (So Far)](https://cooking.nytimes.com/68861692-nyt-cooking/13395693-our-50-most-popular-recipes-of-all-time-so-far): NYT Cooking's 50 most popular recipes curated by editors.
- [Easy Recipes](https://cooking.nytimes.com/topics/easy-recipes): Easy recipes for meatloaf, chili, pasta and quick weeknight meals.
- [Healthy Recipes](https://cooking.nytimes.com/topics/healthy-recipes): Wholesome healthy recipes from workday lunches to Sunday stews.
- [Easy Weeknight Recipes](https://cooking.nytimes.com/topics/easy-weeknight): Easy weeknight recipes including air fryer and chicken dishes.
- [Dinner Recipes](https://cooking.nytimes.com/topics/dinner-recipes): Dinner recipe collections curated by NYT Cooking editors.

## Weeknight & Quick Meals

- [Quick Dinner Recipes](https://cooking.nytimes.com/68861692-nyt-cooking/43843372-quick-recipes): Fast dinner recipes for hectic days, ready in 25 minutes.
- [Healthy Dinner Recipes](https://cooking.nytimes.com/68861692-nyt-cooking/2110373-healthy-weeknight-dinners): Quick healthy dinner recipes ready in an hour from NYT Cooking.
- [One-Pot (or Sheet-Pan) Dinner Recipes](https://cooking.nytimes.com/68861692-nyt-cooking/2370458-one-pot-dinner-recipes): One-pot and sheet-pan dinner recipes for easy weeknight cooking.
- [Easy Side Dishes](https://cooking.nytimes.com/68861692-nyt-cooking/44373459-easy-side-dishes): Simple side dish recipes for weeknight cooking from NYT Cooking.
- [Quick Pasta Recipes](https://cooking.nytimes.com/68861692-nyt-cooking/44347054-quick-pasta-recipes): Quick pasta recipes under 25 minutes with minimal ingredients.

## Protein-Focused Recipes

- [Easy Chicken Recipes](https://cooking.nytimes.com/68861692-nyt-cooking/2576790-easy-chicken-recipes): Easy chicken recipes from breast to sheet-pan thigh ideas.
- [Our Best Pasta Recipes](https://cooking.nytimes.com/topics/our-best-pasta-recipes): Best pasta recipes: shrimp, chicken, vegan and vegetarian options.
- [Best Soup and Stew Recipes](https://cooking.nytimes.com/68861692-nyt-cooking/638891-best-soup-stew-recipes): Curated collection of best soup and stew recipes from NYT Cooking.

## Vegetarian & Plant-Based

- [Easy Vegetarian Recipes](https://cooking.nytimes.com/68861692-nyt-cooking/2274598-easy-30-minute-vegetarian-recipes): Easy 30-minute vegetarian recipes from tabbouleh to air-fryer tofu.
- [Sheet-Pan Vegetarian Recipes](https://cooking.nytimes.com/68861692-nyt-cooking/113085175-sheet-pan-vegetarian-recipes): One-pan meatless weeknight meals from NYT Cooking.
- [From The Veggie by Tanya Sichynsky](https://cooking.nytimes.com/68861692-nyt-cooking/41186253-from-the-veggie-newsletter-by-tanya-sichynsky): Weekly vegetarian recipes and video series by Tanya Sichynsky.

## Baking & Desserts

- [Easy Baking Recipes](https://cooking.nytimes.com/68861692-nyt-cooking/20651790-easy-baking-recipes): Easy baking recipes for cookies, cakes and desserts.

## Newsletters & Curated Guides

- [From Our Cooking Newsletter](https://cooking.nytimes.com/68861692-nyt-cooking/1640510-sam-siftons-suggestions): NYT Cooking newsletter recipes selected by editors, six times weekly.
- [Five Weeknight Dishes](https://cooking.nytimes.com/68861692-nyt-cooking/11249289-weekly-plan): Emily Weinstein's weeknight recipe newsletter from NYT Cooking.

## Breakfast

- [Breakfast Ideas and Recipes](https://cooking.nytimes.com/topics/breakfast): Breakfast recipes: pancakes, scrambled eggs and healthy options.
